title: 第3515章 必须大出血第3514章 可喜可贺
content_zh:
听到万法至尊仙帝的解释，苏尘不由眉梢微皱。
也就是说……
那个光耀仙帝，他必需将其真身摧毁，然后将其本体的修炼核心重创，万法至尊仙帝才能强行吞噬掉他的神魂？
这比他一开始的预估，还要稍弱一些啊！
不过……
这只是针对光耀仙帝的本体！
对方那些第二真身、身外化身的神魂意志，可就没有那么难以被吞噬了！
特别是对方手中的那些鸿蒙至宝、太初至宝……
既然敢来攻打葬天教，那就必须让他们大出血一场才行！
不然的话，今后岂不是随便一个古仙一族，都敢前来攻打葬天教？
苏尘迅速扫视了一圈战场，仔细盘点！
光耀仙帝本体手中，拥有一件真正的太初仙器——那杆方天画戟！
其中一道第二真身手中，竟然也有一件真正的太初仙器，一把湛蓝巨剑！
其他那些第二真身手中，还有三件半步太初仙器，五件太初原矿！
除此之外……
光耀仙帝本体手中，以及那些第二真身、身外化身手中，还有一百多件鸿蒙至宝！
其中，光是真正的鸿蒙仙器，就有三十多件！
至于那些普通化身手中，更是掌握着近万件天级仙器，以及更多的地级仙器！
“嘶……”
“不愧是一个古仙一族的掌权者！”

“不愧是一尊传说中的仙帝强者！”
“他的身价，都快赶上我了！”
苏尘忍不住倒吸一口凉气，无比震撼的喃喃说道。
他刚才的注意力，一直都放在战斗上面。
直到这一刻，他才看清楚，眼前这个光耀仙帝，究竟有多么富有！
光是太初至宝，就有十件！
“哼，一旦被他发现，我拥有强行抹除器灵的手段，他肯定会有所针对！”
“所以接下来，我从他手中夺取那些太初至宝的机会并不多！”
“所以，一定要谨慎一些才好！”
苏尘暗中沟通三大真我，瞬间制订了一个简单的作战计划。
谁知。
还不等苏尘和三大真我付诸行动……
就在这时。
光耀仙帝接连斩爆了三千多条仙龙之后，身形一闪，再次出现在苏尘的头顶上方。
忽然朝着苏尘张口一喷……
一道完全由时光之力凝聚而成的水花，直接落在苏尘身上！
苏尘脸色剧变！
他瞬间察觉到，那朵水花，和时光长河的浪花，已经有了七分相似！
但其杀伤之力，却是更加恐怖一些！
苏尘不免大吃一惊，这个光耀仙帝，居然还掌握着这么恐怖的底牌手段？先前居然一直都没有使用出来！
content_en:
After hearing the explanation from the Supreme Immortal Emperor of All Laws, Su Chen couldn't help but frown slightly.
That is to say...
That Brilliant Immortal Emperor, he had to destroy his true body and then severely damage his cultivation core so that the Supreme Immortal Emperor of All Laws could forcibly devour his soul?
This is slightly weaker than what he initially expected!
But...
This is only for the body of the Immortal Emperor Guangyao!
The other party's second true body and the soul will of the incarnation outside the body are not so difficult to be swallowed!
Especially those Hongmeng Treasures and Taichu Treasures in the opponent's hands...
Since you dare to attack the Burial Heaven Sect, you must let them bleed a lot!
Otherwise, wouldn’t any Ancient Immortal clan dare to attack the Burial Heaven Sect in the future?
Su Chen quickly scanned the battlefield and took stock carefully!
In the hands of Immortal Emperor Guangyao, he possesses a true Immortal Artifact of Taichu - the Fangtian Painted Halberd!
In the hands of one of the second true bodies, there is actually a real Taichu immortal weapon, a blue giant sword!
In the hands of the other second true bodies, there are three half-step Taichu immortal weapons and five pieces of Taichu raw ore!
Besides that…
In the hands of Guangyao Immortal Emperor, as well as in the hands of his second true body and external incarnations, there are more than a hundred Hongmeng treasures!
Among them, there are more than thirty real Hongmeng Immortal Weapons!
As for those ordinary incarnations, they hold nearly 10,000 heaven-level immortal weapons, and more earth-level immortal weapons!
"Hiss..."
"He is worthy of being the leader of the ancient immortal clan!"
"He is indeed a legendary powerful Immortal Emperor!"
"His worth is almost as good as mine!"
Su Chen couldn't help but take a breath of cold air and murmured in great shock.
His focus just now has been on the battle.
It wasn't until this moment that he saw clearly how rich the glorious Immortal Emperor in front of him was!
There are ten of the Supreme Treasures of Taichu alone!
"Hmph, once he discovers that I have the means to forcibly erase the weapon spirit, he will definitely take action!"
"So next, I don't have many chances to seize those Taichu treasures from him!"
"So, you have to be more cautious!"
Su Chen secretly communicated with the three true selves and instantly formulated a simple battle plan.
Who knows.
Before Su Chen and the three true selves take action...
Just then.
After the Immortal Emperor Guangyao killed more than 3,000 immortal dragons one after another, he flashed and appeared above Su Chen's head again.
Suddenly he opened his mouth and sprayed...
A water splash completely condensed by the power of time fell directly on Su Chen!
Su Chen's expression changed drastically!
He instantly realized that the water splash was seventy-nine similar to the waves in the river of time!
But its killing power is even more terrifying!
Su Chen couldn't help but be shocked. This Guangyao Immortal Emperor actually had such a terrifying trump card? It has never been used before!
